# Dopterae
Nomadic mothfolk with an unknown homeworld, bringing their love of stories and legends wherever they may roam.
## Species Traits - Damage Resistances: Cold -30% - Damage Weaknesses: Heat +30% - Species Accent: Prolonged z's - Special Diet: Can only eat fruits and fabrics (e.g. clothes, plushies) - Improved acceleration in zero-gravity environments thanks to their wings
## Naming Traditions Dopterae do not have static naming structures, instead borrowing ones from the many species they may interact with.
